name: Beebole
desc: Time tracking and project management. Create companies, projects, people, and log time entries.

actions.name: create_person
actions.description: Creates a new person in Beebole. An available license is required for the person to be active.

actions.name: create_company
actions.description: Creates a new company (customer) in Beebole.

actions.name: create_project
actions.description: Creates a new project under a company in Beebole.

actions.name: create_subproject
actions.description: Creates a new subproject under an existing project in Beebole.

actions.name: deactivate_subproject
actions.description: Marks a subproject as inactive in Beebole. Inactive subprojects are hidden from new time entries.

actions.name: create_multiple_time_entries
actions.description: Creates time entries (working time or absence) across multiple days in Beebole.

actions.name: delete_multiple_time_entries
actions.description: Deletes multiple time entries (working time or absence) by their IDs and dates.

actions.name: custom_api_call
actions.description: Make a custom API call to a specific endpoint
